summary.intent: Bootstrap the release-please system (from phase 41) with correct version tags, align api-client versions with the API, and test the new release pipeline with a quick task exposing the API version on the /health endpoint.
summary.outcome: Bootstrap tags created, api-client versions aligned to 0.35.0, /health endpoint now returns version field with full OpenAPI schema coverage, and the post-merge release-as injection was refactored from a direct-to-main push into a PR-branch commit via the preview workflow — eliminating the branch protection bypass requirement.

repo: release-please treats the entire commit history as unreleased when no prior tags exist; bootstrap tags at the last known-good SHA are required to get a clean initial changelog

The OpenAPI spec is generated manually in apps/api/scripts/generate-openapi.ts (not from HealthController directly) because HealthController depends on TypeOrmHealthIndicator and cannot be instantiated without a real DB connection
The project uses 15 release-please packages across JS (apps/api, apps/web, apps/desktop, packages/*) and Rust crates
API version is now read from npm_package_version / package.json and shared via apps/api/src/version.ts to avoid duplication between main.ts and health.controller.ts
release-please only tracks commits to main; committing release-as targets to the release-please branch has no effect on its behavior
Merge commits from the release-please PR were being parsed by the pr-release-preview script, causing false positive bump labels across many packages — fixed by filtering commits with 2+ parents
fix: commit type triggers a patch bump in release-please; CI-only changes that touch workflow files should use chore(ci): to avoid unnecessary version bumps
The repo uses legacy branch protection rules (not rulesets), which lack per-actor bypass — making direct pushes to main from GitHub Actions difficult without granting broad bypass

code.finding: Health endpoint is manually defined in the OpenAPI spec here rather than auto-generated; the version and schema fields must be maintained manually when health response shape changes
Shared version module created to centralize package.json version reading, used by both main.ts and health.controller.ts
Merge commit filtering added here — commits with 2+ parents are skipped to prevent false bump labels from release-please version PRs
openapi.json added as an extra file with jsonpath $.info.version so release-please bumps it alongside apps/api version
Workflow now commits release-as targets back to the PR branch during preview, replacing the post-merge push approach. Fork PRs are guarded. Concurrency group added to prevent races.

workflow: Squash merging to main means the squash commit message type (feat/fix/chore) determines release-please bump — all commits on a PR must be considered when choosing the squash message type
When force-rewriting commits to change message type, soft reset + re-commit is cleaner than interactive rebase in this context
pnpm api:generate must be run after any OpenAPI schema changes and the result committed; the generated openapi.json and api-client dist are checked in
Committing with GITHUB_TOKEN does not trigger new workflow runs — GitHub's built-in recursion prevention handles the infinite loop concern when workflows commit back to branches

CodeRabbit and GitHub Copilot automated review is active; fix: commits used to address their comments can themselves trigger unwanted version bumps — use chore(fix): or similar scoped messages for review fixes on CI-only PRs

friction: Branch protection (legacy rules) blocked the post-merge GitHub Actions push to main — no per-actor bypass option available, requiring a full architecture change to the release-as injection approach
Cargo.lock regeneration pulled in many unrelated dependency updates when only the crate version was changed; had to manually restore and patch only the specific entry
git index.lock stale file left by a crashed process blocked git operations mid-session
Auto-merge on PR #428 showed as enabled in UI but GITHUB_TOKEN reported autoMergeRequest as null — had to manually merge
Unused import in pr-release-preview.js caused a lint failure on commit
Background task failure notification for an already-handled commit caused confusion
open_items: PR #430 (release-please) changelog should be verified after PR #431 merges — the post-merge release-as injection is now handled via the preview workflow and this needs end-to-end validation
Phase 41 discussion log specified monotonic (major.minor) versioning for web and desktop apps, but semver is in use — deferred for now, documented as a future revisit
The generate-openapi.ts script still instantiates a manual health schema — if new fields are added to the health response, the manual spec definition at line ~250 must be kept in sync manually

Bootstrap tags were created but the release-please workflow re-run after PR #428 merge was not explicitly verified — PR #430 changelog should be reviewed for completeness after the new preview workflow lands
